title: How kids feel about AI, in their own words
summary: When we set out to talk to kids about artificial intelligence, we thought we knew what we’d hear. title: Flock is tightening its rules in response to a growing surveillance backlash
summary: The police-tech giant Flock is announcing today that it will change officers’ access to its nationwide network of license plate readers, in an apparent effort to quell a growing backlash and win back contracts lost amid concerns about mass surveillance and police abuse.
